Static Weights & High Cost

- Cannot reflect real-time inventory
- Still prone to factual hallucinations

High Error Rate on Complex Joins
- LLMs fail on schemas > 10 tables
- Misinterprets ambiguous column names
- Cannot resolve visual flowchart policies
